objects.description: [ZxShell](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0412) can disable the firewall by modifying the registry key HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\StandardProfile.(Citation: Talos ZxShell Oct 2014)
objects.description_fa: [ZxShell](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0412) می‌تواند فایروال را با تغییر کلید رجیستری HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\StandardProfile غیرفعال کند.(Citation: Talos ZxShell Oct 2014)
